method: 5 paired warm EXPLAIN ANALYZE BUFFERS samples per profile; AB/BA alternating index presence; no-index DROP INDEX rolled back; no rebuild between paired samples.
limitations: Synthetic warm-cache timings; these are not production percentiles.
This experiment isolates index presence in wide-query reads; index creation, storage and write costs remain separate.
cache_state: Warm-up performed for both states; shared reads remain observable; fully resident or cold-cache state is not claimed.
